statistical_unit: Seed. Equal-weight condition means within each seed, then equal-weight seed means. 95% intervals use t(0.975,n_seed-1)*s/sqrt(n_seed); unclipped and approximate. They are not guarantees of candidate-level error or simultaneous coverage.
undefined_policy: Nulls omitted within a seed and their case IDs/counts explicitly recorded. A fully undefined seed is omitted and reported. A no-support case is not assigned precision 1 or 0.
latency_policy: Mean of per-case accepted-candidate median delays; conditional on acceptance, not median latency of all born candidates.
